fluff.overview: Federated Suns infantry benefit from one of the strongest industrial bases in the Inner Sphere, with AFFS quartermasters able to supply platoons with standardized equipment and ammunition from a logistics network that few rival states can match. Foot infantry remain the backbone of AFFS planetary garrisons, cheap enough to deploy in numbers across the Federated Suns' vast territory and reliable enough to hold ground that BattleMech forces cannot permanently occupy. Carrying infantry-scale gauss rifles that use magnetic acceleration to propel projectiles at extreme velocities, these platoons field the longest-ranged and hardest-hitting personal ballistic weapon available to conventional soldiers.
